I'll be making the final decision on whether personnel may enter the vessel and what controls are required. The vessel has been isolated from normal production service, and our routine confined-space entry procedure applies. Before I authorize the work, I need to conduct our standard review with maintenance, quality, production planning, and industrial hygiene. So let's go around the table — I'd like each of you to provide a concise statement of any confirmed requirement in your area so we can settle the entry controls and work-package commitments. Let's start with maintenance.
